description_zh: 王阳明主要哲学著作。由门人记录编辑的语录、书信、对话汇编，为阳明心学的核心文本。
description_en: Primary philosophical work. Anthology of sayings, correspondence, and dialogues recorded and compiled by disciples; the core text of Yangming School philosophy.

title_en: Daxuewen / Inquiry on the Great Learning
description_zh: 王阳明为门人所作《大学》诠释，短而精审，为阳明学入门读物。
description_en: Commentary on the Great Learning composed for disciples; brief but densely argued; serves as an introduction to Yangmingism.

title_zh: 王文成公全书 / 王阳明全集
title_en: Complete Works of Wang Wencheng / Collected Works of Wang Yangming
description_zh: 王阳明诗文、奏疏、书信、哲学著作的总集。1572年谢廷杰编刻。
description_en: Collected works including poetry, memorials, letters, and philosophical writings. First compiled and published in 1572 by Xie Tingjie.
